text:
marie: Heads-up: change window tonight 22:00-23:30 UTC. Need a prod deploy for v1.23.0 (pin). Who can approve and actually run it? MFA required per policy.

oliver: I can run but my deploy key rotates at 21:45, might need a quick handoff.

sanjay: I can approve but hitting MFA enrollment reminder, brb enrolling.

emily: I'm on call tonight, can run deploy if we do a canary then full. Confirming rollback plan?

marie: Rollback: canary 5% -> monitor 10m -> 50% -> full, rollback to v1.22.4 if >2% error regression or latency +150ms p95. Release notes pinned in #release-notes.

deploy-bot: POLICY CHECK: deploy request for v1.23.0 requires two deployer approvals OR ops-lead sign-off due to version pin. Current approvers: oliver (ok), sanjay (pending MFA).

sanjay: MFA done, I approve. :white_check_mark:

oliver: Confirming: will perform the deploy. Need temporary elevated session from infra for the handoff window (deploy-role with session ttl 2h).

emily: infra-ops can you issue a scoped token? Example command we need: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::...:role/deploy-role --duration-seconds 7200`

release-coordinator-bot: Release notes published: https://internal/release-notes/1.23.0 — includes migration notes and downgrade steps.

infra-admin (via DM): created session `deploy-role` for oliver, expires in 2h. Audit log id=aud-20240301-58.

oliver: Starting canary deploy now. Command: `rdw-deploy release v1.23.0 --env prod --canary 5 --wait 600`

deploy-bot: Rollout started (id=rld-7771). Canary at 5%. Monitoring hooks engaged.

10m later...
emily: Canary looks fine, p95 latency +20ms, errors unchanged. Proceed to 50%.

oliver: Advancing to 50% -> `rdw-deploy roll rld-7771 --to 50`

deploy-bot: Progress: 50% traffic, no regressions detected in last 5m.

~12 minutes after full->

deploy-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx on route /chat/stream. Spike at 2.8% sustained for 6m.

emily: I'm seeing increased queueing on GPU workers, looks like a KV cache miss storm.

marie: Decision time: rollback or retry with config tweak (raise batch timeout)? We should follow rollback gate if errors >2% and persistent.

oliver: Initiating rollback to v1.22.4. `rdw-deploy rollback rld-7771 --target v1.22.4`

deploy-bot: Rollback started (id=rbk-3332). Canary rollback to 5% first.

release-coordinator-bot: Notifying product and support. Postmortem stub created: https://internal/postmortems/rbk-3332

emily: After rollback, I'll collect traces and pod logs, will open an eval against the promptset to reproduce.

marie: Thanks team. Action items: (1) emily to prod triage logs & KV metrics, (2) ops to validate deploy-role TTL expiry and rotate keys, (3) follow-up run with model quantization disabled for next attempt.

oliver: Confirmed rollback complete, traffic back to v1.22.4, health stable.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Audit: aud-20240301-58 applied.

marie: Filing short deploy postmortem tonight. We'll schedule a follow-up deploy window after fixes. :calendar:
